intervals.label: collaboration: approval
intervals.locator: Greybook record for NA34/2 (JSON, experiment details)
intervals.note: Approval date as recorded in Greybook for NA34/2 (synonym IONS/HELIOS); Specht (2014 slides) lists NA34-2 as approved 11/1984. The interval ends when the first oxygen-ion beams reached the SPS (autumn 1986).

intervals.label: collaboration: ion-beam data taking (oxygen and sulphur beams)
intervals.locator: Specht 2014 slides, 'Results with beams of 16O/32S' slide; Tserruya 1998, Table II
intervals.note: Dates are those of the first-generation SPS ion-beam period (first oxygen beam 1986, first sulphur beam 1987, last sulphur beam 1992; Specht), within which HELIOS took oxygen and sulphur data (the first HELIOS oxygen results were published in 1988; Tserruya: HELIOS-2 used the O and S beams). No fetched source gives HELIOS-specific run dates.
intervals.quote: Beam times: first 16O 1986 first 32S 1987 last 32S 1992 Energies 60 and 200 AGeV

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.locator: Specht 2014 slides, 'Results with beams of 16O/32S' slide
intervals.note: Terminal event inferred from the end of the sulphur-beam period (1992); no fetched source states the end of HELIOS ion running. HELIOS proton-beam work and the HELIOS-3 (NA34/3) dimuon experiment continued separately (HELIOS publications run to 1996).
